summary: Engine V2 Coach Dashboard Publish backend — comprehensive E2E test coverage. All 6 endpoints validated: goal-config status classifier (COMPLETE/PARTIAL/MISSING), exceptions tray with resolve idempotency, Draft vs Live compare, Safe Publish with all 422/409 gates (unresolved_blocking_exceptions, stale_draft), and client V2 Live-read auth gates. Full happy-path lifecycle executed against Pietro (c4c7c7dd-...): kickoff -> exceptions list (1 IMPORTANT unfilled) -> publish blocked -> resolve KEY/IMPORTANT exceptions -> publish succeeds -> compare shows has_live=true. 25 passed, 2 intentional skips (config_missing + PARTIAL ack gates can't be triggered against Pietro whose goal is running.marathon COMPLETE; both are covered by classifier unit tests + code review). One MINOR SPEC DISCREPANCY found: publish stale_draft returns HTTP 409 in code but problem statement specifies 422 — behaviour semantically correct; only status code mismatch.

minor.issue: Stale-draft path returns HTTP 409 (feature_v2_engine_v2_publish.py:478) but problem statement spec says 422 stale_draft. Detail body correctly contains {code: 'stale_draft', current_draft_id}. Consider unifying to 422 to match the other publish gates (config_missing, partial_config_ack_required, unresolved_blocking_exceptions all return 422). Test accepts either status.

action_items: OPTIONAL/NICE-TO-HAVE: Change HTTPException(409, ...) to HTTPException(422, ...) for stale_draft in feature_v2_engine_v2_publish.py L478 to match the rest of the publish-gate status-code contract (all other 4 gates use 422). Not blocking — detail payload already exposes {code: 'stale_draft'} which is what UI/clients should key off.

OPTIONAL: expose Pietro-like client credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md so future testers can hit /api/v2/client/plan/live end-to-end with a real Engine V2-enabled client and validate placements/session_specs shape.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_v2_engine_v2_publish.py is 695 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into publish_flows.py / exception_tray.py / client_read.py if further growth expected.

Compare endpoint (L355) doesn't include an 'unchanged' list in the response body (only 'unchanged' count in summary). The problem statement lists 'unchanged' as one of the returned arrays — currently only count is returned. Frontend may need this list.

Publish flow uses two update_one calls to upsert exception_resolutions (L331 pull + L335 push) — not wrapped in a Mongo transaction. Low risk since only single doc but worth noting for future hardening.
publish endpoint deactivates prev Live and inserts new Live via two separate ops (L546, L582) with no transaction — race window exists but low risk given single coach per client.
seed_data_creation: Test regenerated Pietro's draft via kickoff endpoint (planning_window_weeks=4). Test also published Pietro's plan to plan_live_v2 as part of happy-path; a subsequent kickoff created a fresh draft. Pietro is left in state: latest draft exists post-publish, plan_live_v2 has an active Live doc from the test publish.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_engine_v2_publish_e2e.py is now the canonical E2E for Engine V2 publish/exception/compare/live-read. It regenerates Pietro's draft each run and completes the full lifecycle. Pietro's active Live plan will be replaced on each run. Test uses BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Two tests are intentionally skipped: config_missing gate (would require changing Pietro's goal_key to unknown) and partial_config_ack_required (Pietro's goal is running.marathon COMPLETE). Both are covered by classifier unit tests. To exercise those gates in future, seed a client whose profile.primary_goal_type is unset or set to a PARTIAL-configured goal (e.g. running.5k).
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Sole minor finding: stale_draft returns 409 vs spec's 422. Root cause: feature_v2_engine_v2_publish.py L478 uses HTTPException(409, ...) while all other publish gates (config_missing L488, partial_config_ack_required L494, unresolved_blocking_exceptions L516, incomplete_workout_construction L536) use HTTPException(422, ...). Reproduce: POST publish with draft_id='nonexistent' -> receives 409 with detail.code='stale_draft'. Mitigation: one-line change of 409 to 422.
